title: 1904 Chilean cattle mutilations

tellings.quote: in 1904 there's like this Chilean cattle mutilation series

plain: In 1904, Michels says, Chile saw a series of cattle mutilations, meaning livestock found dead and cut in ways nobody could explain. He mentions it briefly, attributing it to the YouTuber Chris Ramsay, and gives no other details. If true, it would place such cases decades before the ones usually discussed.
